Applied.doc:
What `apply_delta_on` did. The block's spans come back either way, so a
refused write hands the client exactly the state it has to rebase onto.

fields.name: applied
fields.doc: `true` when the steps were written, `false` when the write was refused.

fields.name: token
fields.doc: The undo token for `undo`; `null` on a refusal.

fields.name: spans
fields.doc: The block's spans after the write, or the current ones on a refusal.

fields.name: anchor
fields.doc: The gap after this write's last change, or on a refusal the anchor sent.

fields.name: anchor_pos
fields.doc: Where `anchor` sits in `spans`.

fields.name: ids
fields.doc: The id of each character of `spans`, so a refused write rebases by identity.

Block.doc:
One rendered block, mirroring `BlockView` so its id is the same bs58 token
every other method takes and returns.

fields.name: id
fields.doc: The block id every method takes as `block`. Opaque; pass it back unchanged.

fields.name: kind
fields.doc: The block type, as stored by `insert_block` or `set_kind`.

fields.name: depth
fields.doc: Nesting depth, 0 for top level.

fields.name: attrs
fields.doc: The block's attributes, such as `level` on a heading.

fields.name: spans
fields.doc: The block's text as runs of equally formatted characters, in order.

fields.name: ids
fields.doc: The id of each character of `spans`, in order.

Change.doc:
One step of a text change, in Quill's delta shape: `{"retain": 6}`, `{"insert": "text"}` or `{"delete": 2}`.
A `retain` or `insert` step also carries `attributes`: an object of formatting, or `null` for none.

variants.name: Retain
variants.doc: Keeps `retain` characters, optionally changing their formatting.

variants.name: Insert
variants.doc: Inserts text at the current position.

variants.name: Delete
variants.doc: Removes characters at the current position.

fields.name: delete
fields.doc: How many characters to remove.

fields.name: insert
fields.doc: The text to insert.

fields.name: attributes
fields.doc: Formatting of the inserted text.

fields.name: retain
fields.doc: How many characters to keep.

fields.name: attributes
fields.doc: Formatting to set on the kept characters; `null` leaves it as is.

Comment.doc:
A per-document comment, owned by its author. Stored in an `AuthoredMap`, so
the runtime stamps the writer's identity and a per-entry schema version on
insert; only the owner can re-sign it (the basis of the migration banner).

The value type is intentionally STABLE across schema versions - the v1→v2
migration bumps the *state* schema and adds a top-level marker, never a
field inside `Comment` (changing an authored value type is a content
rewrite, a different and harder migration class).

fields.name: doc_id
fields.doc:
Which doc this annotates. Immutable after create. Indexed, so one doc's
comments are a seek rather than a walk of the folder's.

fields.name: body
fields.doc: The comment text.

fields.name: created_at
fields.doc: Immutable after create.

CommentDto.doc: Flat projection of a `Comment` for list / get APIs.

fields.name: id
fields.doc: The comment id.

fields.name: author
fields.doc: Hex account of the comment's author, from its owner stamp.

fields.name: doc_id
fields.doc: The document the comment is on.

fields.name: body
fields.doc: The comment text.

fields.name: created_at
fields.doc: When the comment was added, in nanoseconds since the Unix epoch.

DocDto.doc:
Flat projection of a `DocRecord` for list / get APIs. The body is read
through `get_document` / `get_block_delta`, never flattened into a string.

fields.name: id
fields.doc: The document id.

fields.name: title
fields.doc: The title text.

fields.name: tags
fields.doc: Keys only, sorted; the registry maps each to a name and colour.

fields.name: archived
fields.doc: Whether the document is archived.

fields.name: created_at
fields.doc: When the document was created, in nanoseconds since the Unix epoch; 0 when the creator cannot be determined.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.doc: When the document last changed, in nanoseconds since the Unix epoch.

fields.name: created_by
fields.doc: Hex account of whoever created the doc, from its header's owner stamp.

fields.name: updated_by
fields.doc: Hex account of whoever last changed the document.

fields.name: can_delete
fields.doc: Whether the caller may delete it: the same rule `delete_doc` enforces.

DocRecord.doc:
Per-document record.

`#[app::mergeable]` supplies the deterministic re-key cascade `title`, `body`
and `tags` need: a nested collection stored under a value type that is not a
registered `RekeyTarget` keeps a per-replica random storage id and never
converges.

`Searchable`: the node's full-text index holds each doc's title (weighted
double) and body text, formatting left out; `search_docs` queries it.

fields.name: title
fields.doc: The title, plain text.

fields.name: body
fields.doc: The ordered blocks of the document.

fields.name: tags
fields.doc: The document's tags. A set, so two members tagging the same doc at once both keep their tag.

fields.name: archived
fields.doc: Whether the document is hidden from the default list.

fields.name: updated_at
fields.doc: When the document last changed, in nanoseconds since the Unix epoch.

fields.name: updated_by
fields.doc: Hex account id of the last editor, advanced with `updated_at`.

fields.name: id
fields.doc: The document id.

fields.name: title
fields.doc: The document title.

fields.name: snippet
fields.doc:
A fragment of the title or body around the match, the matched words
wrapped in `<b>`; empty when there is none to show.

fields.name: score
fields.doc: How well the document matched; higher is better.

fields.name: archived
fields.doc: Whether the document is archived.

fields.name: hits
fields.doc: The hits on this page, best match first.

fields.name: total
fields.doc: Documents the index matched in all.

fields.name: next_cursor
fields.doc: Pass back as `cursor` for the next page; `None` on the last.

fields.name: docs
fields.doc:
doc_id → record. Public: collaborative editing. The id is
`doc-<nonce>-<account>-<device tag>` and assigned by `create_doc`.

fields.name: headers
fields.doc:
doc_id → created_at, filed by the doc's creator, whose owner stamp it
carries. A doc is listed while that entry lives; only its creator or a
moderator (the founder) may remove it, and every node enforces that.

fields.name: comments

Run.doc:
A run of character ids, mirroring `IdRange`, which has no `AbiType`.
`replica` is decimal text because a full `u64` loses its top bits as a JSON number in a browser.

fields.name: replica
fields.doc: The replica that wrote the run's first character.

fields.name: counter
fields.doc: That replica's counter for the run's first character.

fields.name: len
fields.doc: How many consecutive characters the run covers.

TitleApplied.doc: What `title_apply_delta_on` did; the title comes back either way.

fields.name: applied
fields.doc: `true` when the steps were written, `false` when the write was refused.

fields.name: token
fields.doc: The undo token for `title_undo`; `null` on a refusal.

fields.name: text
fields.doc: The title after the write, or the current title on a refusal.

fields.name: anchor
fields.doc: The gap after this write's last change, or on a refusal the anchor sent.

fields.name: anchor_pos
fields.doc: Where `anchor` sits in `text`.

fields.name: ids
fields.doc: The id of each character of `text`.

TitleState.doc: The title with the id of each of its characters, in order.

fields.name: text
fields.doc: The title text.

fields.name: ids
fields.doc: The id of each character of `text`, in order.

methods.name: add_comment
methods.doc:
Adds a comment to a document, owned by the caller, and returns its id.
Not idempotent: a retry after a lost response adds a second comment, so check `list_comments` before repeating.

params.name: doc_id
params.doc: The id of the document to comment on.

methods.name: add_tag
methods.doc:
Puts a tag on a document.
Adding a tag the document already has changes nothing.
The tag key must be a registered tag's key for the workspace to show it by name; see the registry's `set_tag`.

params.name: tag
params.doc: The tag key: 1 to 64 characters of lowercase ASCII letters, digits and `-`.

methods.name: anchor_at
methods.doc:
Returns a cursor for the gap at a position in a block's text, as an opaque token that survives concurrent edits and that any member can resolve.
Positions count Unicode scalar values, not bytes or UTF-16 units.

params.name: position
params.doc: The gap, counted from 0 at the start of the text.

params.name: before
params.doc: Which side the anchor leans toward when text is inserted exactly at the gap.

methods.name: apply_delta
methods.doc:
Applies one editing transaction to a block's text, formatting included, and returns a token that `undo` takes.
`ops` is a list of steps that walk the text as it was before the change: `{"retain": 3, "attributes": null}` keeps three characters, `{"insert": "text", "attributes": null}` adds text, `{"delete": 2}` removes two.
Text after the last step is kept.
A `retain` or `insert` step may carry `attributes` to set formatting, for example `{"insert": "hi", "attributes": {"bold": "true"}}`; to clear formatting from a range use `mark` with a `null` value.
Positions count Unicode scalar values, not bytes or UTF-16 units.

params.name: ops
params.doc: The steps of the transaction, in order.

methods.name: apply_delta_on
methods.doc:
Like `apply_delta`, but only applies when the block's text is still exactly `base`, because a position counted in any other text names the wrong place.
When `anchor` is given the write must also be an insert right where that anchor sits.
On refusal nothing is written: `applied` is `false` and `spans` are the block's current spans to rebase onto.

params.name: base
params.doc: The block's full plain text the steps were computed against.

params.name: ops
params.doc: The steps of the transaction, as for `apply_delta`.

params.name: anchor
params.doc: Optional cursor token from `anchor_at`; `null` for an unanchored write.

methods.returns_doc: Whether the write applied, the undo token, the block's spans afterwards, and an anchor at the end of the edit.

methods.name: archive_doc
methods.doc:
Archives a document, which hides it from `list_docs` unless archived documents are requested.
Nothing is deleted and `unarchive_doc` reverses it.

methods.name: comment_count
methods.doc:
Returns how many comments the folder's live documents hold, across all of them.
A comment counts only when it is held by the account its id names.

methods.name: comment_schema_version
methods.doc:
Returns the storage schema version stamped on a comment, or `null` when there is no such comment.
A diagnostic for the web app's migration banner; not needed to read or write comments.

methods.name: create_doc
methods.doc:
Creates a document with the given title and an empty body, and returns its id.
Add the first block with `insert_block`.
Not idempotent: a retry after a lost response creates a second document, so check `list_docs` before repeating.
methods.returns_doc: The new document's id, an opaque string the other methods take as `doc` or `id`.

methods.name: delete_block
methods.doc: Removes a block from a document's body.

methods.name: delete_comment
methods.doc:
Deletes a comment.
Only its author or a moderator of this folder (the member who created the folder's context) may delete it.

methods.name: delete_doc
methods.doc:
Deletes a document, its whole body and its comments permanently.
Only the document's creator or a moderator of this folder (the member who created the folder's context) may delete it; `can_delete` on the document's row says whether the caller may.
A moderator removes every comment on it; the creator removes their own, and the rest are no longer listed.

methods.name: edit_comment
methods.doc:
Replaces a comment's text.
Only the comment's author may edit it.

methods.name: edit_doc
methods.doc:
Renames a document by replacing its whole title.
Character-level title edits go through `title_apply_delta`.

methods.name: get_block
methods.doc: Returns one block with its kind, depth, attributes and formatted text spans.
methods.returns_doc: The block, or `null` when there is no such block.

methods.name: get_block_delta
methods.doc: Returns one block's text as formatted spans, the read an editor binding does on every keystroke.
methods.returns_doc: The spans in order; each has `text` and, when formatted, `attributes`.

methods.name: get_comment
methods.doc:
Returns one comment.
Fails when the comment does not exist.

methods.name: get_doc
methods.doc:
Returns one document's metadata: title, tag keys, archived flag, timestamps, creator, last editor and whether the caller may delete it.
The body is read with `get_document`.
Fails when the document does not exist.

methods.name: get_document
methods.doc: Returns a document's body as an ordered list of blocks, each with its id, kind, depth, attributes and formatted text spans.

methods.name: get_state_digest
methods.doc:
Returns the whole body as one canonical line, so two replicas can be compared by a single value.
Block ids are left out because they differ between nodes.

methods.name: get_text
methods.doc: Returns one block's plain text with formatting stripped.

methods.name: get_title
methods.doc: Returns a document's title text.

methods.name: get_title_state
methods.doc:
Returns a document's title text together with its character ids, read at the same moment so they line up.
Pass the ids to `title_apply_delta_on` so an edit lands where the caller saw it.
methods.returns_doc: The title text and the ids of its characters as runs.

methods.name: insert_block
methods.doc:
Inserts an empty block into a document's body and returns its id.
The body is an ordered list of blocks; each has a `kind`, a `depth` and its own text.
Fill the block with `apply_delta`.
Not idempotent: a retry after a lost response adds a second block, so check `list_blocks` before repeating.

params.name: after
params.doc: The id of the block to insert after; `null` inserts at the top.

params.name: kind
params.doc: The block type, an opaque string stored as given. The Mero Docs editor uses `paragraph`, `heading`, `bulletListItem` and `image`.

params.name: depth
params.doc: Nesting depth, 0 for top level, 1 for a child of the block above, and so on.

methods.name: list_blocks
methods.doc: Returns the ids of a document's blocks in document order.

methods.name: list_comments
methods.doc: Lists one document's comments, in no guaranteed order; sort by `created_at`.
methods.returns_doc: One row per comment, including its author's account id.

methods.name: list_docs
methods.doc:
Lists the documents in this folder's context, in no guaranteed order; sort by `updated_at` for most recent first.
Each row carries metadata only; read a body with `get_document`.

params.name: include_archived
params.doc: `true` to include archived documents, `false` to leave them out.

methods.name: mark
methods.doc:
Sets one formatting key over a range of a block's text, or clears it.
Declared keys: `bold`, `italic`, `underline`, `strike`, `code`, `link`, `comment`, `textColor` and `backgroundColor`; any other key is refused.
Positions count Unicode scalar values, not bytes or UTF-16 units.

params.name: start
params.doc: First position of the range, inclusive.

params.name: value
params.doc: The value, for example `"true"` for `bold` or a URL for `link`; `null` clears the key.

methods.returns_doc: The id of the new mark, or `null` when the range already had that value and nothing was written.

methods.name: merge_blocks
methods.doc: Appends the text of `second` to `first` and removes `second`.

params.name: first
params.doc: The block that keeps its place and receives the text.

params.name: second
params.doc: The block whose text is appended and which is then removed.

methods.name: move_block
methods.doc: Moves a block to just after another block.

params.name: after
params.doc: The block to move it after; `null` moves it to the top.

methods.name: passage_count
methods.doc: Counts how many times a passage appears contiguously in a block's text.

methods.name: remove_tag
methods.doc:
Takes a tag off a document.
Removing a tag the document does not have is not an error.

methods.name: resolve_ids
methods.doc: Returns where anchors currently sit in this node's copy of a block, in one pass.
methods.returns_doc: One position per anchor, in order; `null` for an anchor this node cannot place yet.

methods.name: search_docs
methods.doc:
Searches this folder's documents by title and body, best match first.
Words match as typed or as a prefix of a longer word, and the title counts double.
Archived documents come back only with `include_archived`; deleted ones never do.
The index lives on each node and lags an edit by up to a second.
On a node running with search off this fails; read the documents with `list_docs` and `get_document` instead.

params.name: include_archived
params.doc: `true` to include archived documents, `false` to leave them out.

params.name: cursor
params.doc: `next_cursor` from the previous page, or `null` for the first page.

params.name: limit
params.doc: The most hits per page, or `null` for 20; at most 100.

methods.returns_doc: One page of hits, the total match count, and the cursor for the next page.

methods.name: set_attr
methods.doc: Sets one attribute on a block, such as `level` on a heading, or removes it.

params.name: value
params.doc: The attribute value as a string; `null` removes the attribute.

methods.name: set_depth
methods.doc: Changes a block's nesting depth.

params.name: depth
params.doc: The new depth, 0 for top level.

methods.name: set_kind
methods.doc: Changes a block's type.

params.name: kind
params.doc: The new block type, as for `insert_block`.

methods.name: split_block
methods.doc:
Splits a block in two at a text position and returns the new block, which holds the text after the split and follows the original.
Not idempotent: a retry after a lost response splits again, so read the blocks before repeating.
Positions count Unicode scalar values, not bytes or UTF-16 units.

params.name: at
params.doc: The position to split at; the text from here on moves to the new block.

methods.name: title_anchor_at
methods.doc:
Returns a cursor for the gap at a title position, as an opaque token that survives concurrent edits and that any member can resolve.
Positions count Unicode scalar values, not bytes or UTF-16 units.

params.name: position
params.doc: The gap, counted from 0 at the start of the title.

params.name: before
params.doc: Which side the anchor leans toward when text is inserted exactly at the gap.

methods.name: title_apply_delta
methods.doc:
Applies one editing transaction to a document's title and returns a token that `title_undo` takes.
`ops` is a list of steps that walk the text as it was before the change: `{"retain": 3, "attributes": null}` keeps three characters, `{"insert": "text", "attributes": null}` adds text, `{"delete": 2}` removes two.
Text after the last step is kept.
The title carries no formatting, so a step with non-null `attributes` is refused.
Positions count Unicode scalar values, not bytes or UTF-16 units.

params.name: ops
params.doc: The steps of the transaction, in order.

methods.name: title_apply_delta_on
methods.doc:
Like `title_apply_delta`, but only applies when the title is still exactly `base`, because a position counted in any other text names the wrong place.
When `anchor` is given the write must also be an insert right where that anchor sits.
On refusal nothing is written: `applied` is `false` and `text` is the current title to rebase onto.

params.name: base
params.doc: The full title text the steps were computed against.

params.name: ops
params.doc: The steps of the transaction, as for `title_apply_delta`.

params.name: anchor
params.doc: Optional cursor token from `title_anchor_at`; `null` for an unanchored write.

methods.returns_doc: Whether the write applied, the undo token, the resulting title, and an anchor at the end of the edit.

methods.name: title_resolve
methods.doc: Returns where anchors currently sit in this node's copy of the title.
methods.returns_doc: One position per anchor, in order; `null` for an anchor this node cannot place yet.

methods.name: title_undo
methods.doc: Takes a whole title transaction back and returns a token that redoes it.

params.name: token
params.doc: The token `title_apply_delta` (or a previous undo) returned.

methods.returns_doc: An opaque token that redoes the transaction.

methods.name: unarchive_doc
methods.doc: Restores an archived document to the default `list_docs` view.

methods.name: undo
methods.doc: Takes a whole text transaction back and returns a token that redoes it.

params.name: block
params.doc: The block the transaction was applied to.

params.name: token
params.doc: The token `apply_delta` (or a previous undo) returned.

methods.returns_doc: An opaque token that redoes the transaction.

events.name: BlockChanged
events.doc: Kind, depth or an attribute changed; re-read the block.

events.name: BlockDeleted
events.doc: A block was removed from a document.

events.name: BlockInserted
events.doc: A block was added to a document.

events.name: BlockMoved
events.doc: A block was moved within a document.

events.name: DocTagsChanged
events.doc: A tag was added to or removed from a document.

events.name: MarkApplied
events.doc: A formatting mark was written to a block.

events.name: TextChanged
events.doc: A block's text or formatting was edited or undone.

events.name: TitleChanged
events.doc: A document title was edited or undone.
